name: packed-sdk-admission
goal: The packed verification SDK reports a missing coding verification record before loading optional compiler dependencies, with identical diagnostics in Bun and Node.

evidence: The packed consumer preserves its expected missing-verification-record diagnostic in Bun and Node. At f4dec89d13 the test now explicitly removes UI dependencies after install; it fails with Task evidence could not be read instead of the established diagnostic.

The CLI now declares Svelte, so asserting it absent immediately after install stopped the packaged SDK test before its behavior checks. Explicitly remove only the temporary consumer UI dependencies, retaining both the absence assertion and all public SDK expectations. This reveals eager compiler initialization before the missing-record check.

Frozen packaged consumer at f4dec89d13 fails with Task evidence could not be read instead of the established missing-record error. Red record 0744cb974f0e2d04b01a8844536e7e884ca83dfc0f034a4e5b4547cd6492a40c retains the unchanged SDK assertions.
